notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that has power or toughness 1 or less and that can be cast using one colored mana.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
Cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the additional creature, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from your graveyard by paying its mana cost. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.
